value.chinese_level: TOCFL Band A Level 2 (CEFR A2) or New HSK Level 4

english.quote: Chinese： Chinese proficiency certificate at CEFR (A2 or above) [Please refer to the Chinese Proficiency Test Comparison Chart] Test of Chinese as a Foreign Language (TOCFL) Certificate Level 2 or above
english.how_found: Programme detail page, 'Program Minimum language proficiency requirements'; consistent with OIA Language Proficiency Requirements page and 2027 Sept guidelines (CEFR A2 for Chinese-taught programmes).
english.notes: Chinese proficiency (TOCFL) is required INSTEAD of English: CSIE bachelor is Chinese-taught, so no minimum English test score is required. Waived if previous degree taught in Chinese or majoring in Chinese (proof required). The department RECOMMENDS Chinese CEFR B1+ and English CEFR C1+ (recommendation, not minimum), and its required documents ask for Chinese proof at B1 or one year of Chinese study, or else a statement (max 500 words) on how the applicant plans to improve Chinese. For comparison, NTU's minimum for English-taught programmes is CEFR B2 (e.g. TOEFL iBT 72, IELTS 5.5) - not applicable here. TOCFL certificates must be uploaded as the original PDF from the TOCFL system.

value.description: No published minimum grade/average or test threshold; holistic document review by NTU/department committees. No interview or written exam for CSIE bachelor.

gpa.quote: The NTU committees at different levels will decide whether to grant an offer based on the applicant’s qualification and documents. NTU will select the best candidates for admission based on the decision of the admission committee.
gpa.how_found: 2027/2028 September Entry Admission Guidelines for International Degree Students (PDF), section IV.C; programme page checked for thresholds.
gpa.notes: Programme page: 'Interview / Oral exam None Written exam None'. Required documents: grade 10-12 transcripts, grade explanation, autobiography, academic ranking/percentage (if applicable), 2 recommendation letters, Chinese proficiency proof. Academic requirement is only 'At least a high school diploma or equivalent'. SAT/A-Level/IB results are only supporting documents. Kazakhstan NIS grade 12 diploma = 12-year high school, so eligible; no country-specific rule found.

deadline.quote: 2027 September Entry (1st Round) Open Application Period: September 29 (11AM) – November 5, 2026 (4PM)
deadline.how_found: OIA International Students page 'Online Application System'; confirmed in 2027/2028 September Entry guidelines PDF section X ('November 5, 2026, 4pm Deadline for submitting the online application.').
deadline.notes: This is the September 2027 (fall 2027) cycle, 1st round, deadline 4pm GMT+8. 2nd round: December 1, 2026 (11am) - January 19, 2027 (4pm) -> 2027-01-19; CSIE bachelor is offered in both rounds. 1st-round results January 14, 2027 (scholarship results included); acceptance by January 21, 2027. Scholarship is applied for in the same application (checkbox). As of 2026-10-17 the 1st round is open.

tuition.quote: Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, D-School 35,980 22,960 58,940
tuition.how_found: 2027/2028 September Entry guidelines PDF, Appendix 1 'National Taiwan University 2026/27 Academic Year Tuition and Fees Per Semester for Undergraduate Programs (Currency: NTD)', International Students columns: Tuition / Fees / Total. Cross-checked with OIA Tuition Fees page (EECS 58,940 TWD / ~USD 1,965).
tuition.notes: Amount is tuition (35,980) + fees (22,960) = 58,940 TWD per semester, i.e. about 117,880 TWD per academic year (2 semesters). 2026/27 is the latest published; the guidelines say 2027/2028 fees will be published by the Office of Academic Affairs. Excludes credit fees, insurance, accommodation, etc.

scholarship_exists.how_found: OIA Fees & Scholarships > Scholarships, Undergraduate tab, 'NTU Scholarships for International Students'.
scholarship_exists.notes: Benefits: tuition subsidy up to TWD 100,000/semester + monthly stipend TWD 8,000, for the designated years of study; renewal requires GPA 3.38+ each year. Apply by ticking the scholarship box in the online degree application. Taiwan Scholarship (MOFA/MOE) awardees may not apply. CSIE programme page: 'Scholarship from college or department None'.

scholarship_international.quote: Eligibility: All international degree students can apply.
scholarship_international.how_found: Same scholarship entry on the OIA Scholarships page.
scholarship_international.notes: No nationality restriction (unlike NTU-CEEC/BVI scholarships), so a Kazakhstani applicant can be considered. Guidelines VII: 'Applicants will be asked whether to apply for NTU scholarships during the online degree application. No extra documents are needed.'
